import { existsSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync, mkdirSync, statSync } from 'node:fs'
import { resolve, join, extname } from 'node:path'
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto'
import { createServer } from 'node:http'
import { spawn } from 'node:child_process'
import { pathToFileURL } from 'node:url'
import { child } from './session-lifecycle.mjs'
import { livePreviewScript, watchProject } from './live-preview.mjs'

export function projectType(root) {
  if (existsSync(join(root, 'package.json'))) {
    const p = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'), 'utf8'))
    if (p.dependencies?.next || p.devDependencies?.next) throw new Error('Unsupported framework: customize start.sh and provide static deployment output.')
    if (p.dependencies?.vite || p.devDependencies?.vite) return 'vite'
    throw new Error('Unsupported package project: customize start.sh and deployment output.')
  }
  if (existsSync(join(root, 'index.html'))) return 'html'
  throw new Error('No generated index.html or supported package project.')
}
export async function start(root = process.cwd()) {
  const type = projectType(root)
  const projectRoot = resolve(root)
  if (type === 'vite') {
    const stampDir = process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR || join(root, 'node_modules', '.cache')
    mkdirSync(stampDir, { recursive: true })
    const stamp = join(stampDir, 'default-dependencies')
    const lock = join(root, 'package-lock.json')
    const hash = createHash('sha256').update(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'))).update(existsSync(lock) ? readFileSync(lock) : '').digest('hex')
    let old = ''
    try { old = readFileSync(stamp, 'utf8') } catch {}
    if (old !== hash || !existsSync(join(root, 'node_modules/vite'))) {
      await child('npm', [existsSync(lock) ? 'ci' : 'install', '--no-audit', '--no-fund'], { cwd: root })
      mkdirSync(stampDir, { recursive: true })
      const installedHash = createHash('sha256').update(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'))).update(existsSync(lock) ? readFileSync(lock) : '').digest('hex')
      writeFileSync(stamp, installedHash)
    }
    await child(process.execPath, [join(root, 'node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js'), 'build', '--base', './'], { cwd: root })
    root = join(root, 'dist')
  }
  if (!existsSync(join(root, 'index.html'))) throw new Error('Static deployment output must contain index.html.')
  if (process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR) writeFileSync(join(process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR, 'deployment-output.json'), JSON.stringify({ project: projectRoot, directory: resolve(root) }))
  const mime = { '.html':'text/html', '.js':'application/javascript', '.css':'text/css', '.json':'application/json', '.svg':'image/svg+xml', '.png':'image/png', '.jpg':'image/jpeg', '.webp':'image/webp', '.wasm':'application/wasm', '.glb':'model/gltf-binary' }
  const clients = new Set()
  const stopWatching = watchProject(root, () => { for (const client of clients) client.write('event: change\ndata: changed\n\n') })
  const keepAlive = setInterval(() => { for (const client of clients) client.write(': keepalive\n\n') }, 20000)
  const buildWatcher = type === 'vite' ? spawn(process.execPath, [join(projectRoot, 'node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js'), 'build', '--base', './', '--watch'], { cwd: projectRoot, stdio: 'inherit' }) : null
  const server = createServer((req, res) => {
    try {
      const url = new URL(req.url, 'http://localhost')
      if (url.pathname === '/__omgithub/live') {
        res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'text/event-stream', 'Cache-Control': 'no-cache', 'X-Accel-Buffering': 'no', Connection: 'keep-alive' })
        res.write(': connected\n\n')
        clients.add(res)
        req.on('close', () => clients.delete(res))
        return
      }
      const path = resolve(root, '.' + decodeURIComponent(url.pathname))
      if (path !== resolve(root) && !path.startsWith(resolve(root) + '/')) { res.writeHead(404); res.end(); return }
      const file = statSync(path).isDirectory() ? join(path, 'index.html') : path
      res.setHeader('Content-Type', mime[extname(file)] || 'application/octet-stream')
      res.setHeader('Cache-Control', url.searchParams.has('omgithub_live') ? 'no-store' : 'no-cache')
      const content = readFileSync(file)
      if (extname(file) === '.html' && url.searchParams.get('omgithub_live') === '1') {
        const html = content.toString()
        res.end(/<\/body\s*>/i.test(html) ? html.replace(/<\/body\s*>/i, `${livePreviewScript}</body>`) : html + livePreviewScript)
      } else res.end(content)
    } catch { res.writeHead(404); res.end('Not found') }
  })
  server.on('close', () => { stopWatching(); clearInterval(keepAlive); buildWatcher?.kill(); for (const client of clients) client.end() })
  server.listen(Number(process.env.PORT || 3000), '0.0.0.0')
  return server
}
if (process.argv[1] && import.meta.url === pathToFileURL(process.argv[1]).href) await start()

const transient = error => { throw Object.assign(error, { exitCode: 75 }) }
let browser
try {
  browser = await chromium.launch({ ...config.browser.launchOptions, timeout: 30000 }).catch(transient)
  for (const [name, width, height] of [['desktop', 1440, 900], ['mobile', 390, 844]]) {
    const page = await browser.newPage({ viewport: { width, height } }).catch(transient)
    page.setDefaultTimeout(30000)
    const failures = []
    page.on('pageerror', error => { console.error(error.message); failures.push(error.message) })
    page.on('response', response => { if (response.status() >= 400 && new URL(response.url()).origin === new URL(url).origin) failures.push(`HTTP ${response.status()}: ${response.url()}`) })
    const response = await page.goto(url, { waitUntil: 'load', timeout: 45000 }).catch(transient)
    if (!response?.ok()) throw Object.assign(new Error(`HTTP ${response?.status()} loading preview`), { exitCode: !response || [408, 429, 500, 502, 503, 504].includes(response.status()) ? 75 : 1 })
    await page.locator(process.env.CAPTURE_READY_SELECTOR || 'body').waitFor({ state: 'visible' })
    await page.waitForFunction(() => document.fonts.status === 'loaded')
    const start = await startForCapture(page, {
      enabled: process.env.CAPTURE_AUTO_START !== 'false',
      selector: process.env.CAPTURE_START_SELECTOR || ''
    })
    console.log(`Capture ${name}: auto-start ${start.clicked ? 'clicked' : start.reason}`)
    await page.waitForTimeout(1000)
    await page.screenshot({ path: join(output, `final-${name}.png`), timeout: 30000 }).catch(error => {
      if (error.name === 'TimeoutError' || !browser.isConnected()) transient(error)
      throw error
    })
    if (process.env.CAPTURE_STRICT === '1' && failures.length) throw new Error(`Published build failed: ${failures.join('; ')}`)
    await page.close()
  }
} catch (error) { console.error(error); process.exitCode = error.exitCode || 1 }
finally { await browser?.close().catch(error => { console.error(error); process.exitCode ||= 75 }) }

## Objective
- Build a complete, self-contained, paste-ready HTML5 3D pinball game for mobile/tablet in 9:16 portrait, with zombie apocalypse/security-team theme, detailed animated dachshund, procedural levels, power-ups, sound, ranking, difficulties, and animated main menu.
- Required credits: developer **BANDOS7**, **Made in Germany**, version **1.1.1**.

## Requirements
- One-finger mobile controls.
- 9:16 portrait format, phone/tablet responsive.
- Ranking and multiple difficulty levels.
- Game sound and animated main menu.
- Pinball gameplay featuring zombies and security teams.
- Diverse power-ups, procedural levels, extras.
- Dark atmosphere, high quality, very detailed dachshund animation.
- Everything clearly visible; playfield must not be covered by UI.
- HTML5 copy/paste version.
- 3D game.
- Build now without clarifying questions; note assumptions briefly at finish.

## Decisions
- Using self-contained single-file `index.html` with Three.js r160 UMD inlined (`vendor/three.min.js`, ~670 KB).
- Custom 2D circle/segment physics rendered through Three.js, not a physics engine.
- Canvas is placed in dedicated stage area between HUD and controls so UI does not overlap the playfield.
- Audio and visual assets are fully procedural (Web Audio, Canvas textures, primitive-based 3D models).
- Local ranking stored in `localStorage`; seeded rankings included.
- One-finger control scheme: left/right flipper buttons plus a central launch button.
- Main menu and in-game apron both feature animated dachshund models.
- Difficulty keys: `recruit`, `veteran`, `nightmare`.
- LocalStorage keys: `wummi_rank_111`, `wummi_settings_111`.

## Work State
### Completed
- Full template/CSS/JS source authored in `src/shell.html`, `src/style.css`, `src/app.js`.
- Three.js vendored.
- Build script `build.mjs` generates single-file `index.html`.
- Renderer, menu scene, game table, dachshund model, zombies, guards, drones, effects, particles, procedural textures, audio engine, physics, procedural stage generation, power-ups, K9 special attack, security relay strikes, HUD, difficulty UI, ranking, briefing, pause, game-over, touch/keyboard input, debug API.
- `index.html` built successfully at ~832 KB.
- `node --check src/app.js` currently passes.

### Active
- Needs runtime browser verification and visual/behavioral fixes.
- Server and screenshots have not been started/tested yet.
- Need check for layout/overlap, menu composition, game camera framing, dog visibility, physics, JS runtime exceptions.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Start server (`./start.sh` or runtime start script) and open in Playwright/Chromium.
2. Capture 390×844 and desktop screenshots; inspect menu and gameplay.
3. Fix runtime bugs and layout/camera issues.
4. Click `#startBtn`, launch ball, verify physics/scoring/procedural stage/dog/power-ups/ranking.
5. Test game-over modal and localStorage ranking.
6. Rebuild `index.html` after changes; rerun syntax/runtime checks.
7. Deliver concise final note including assumptions and credits/version.

## Relevant Files
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html`: final built single-file paste version; rerun build after source edits.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/app.js`: main game logic, scenes, physics, UI, audio; currently passes syntax check.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/style.css`: all UI/layout/menu/game styling.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/shell.html`: HTML structure and `/*__CSS__*/`, `/*__THREE__*/`, `/*__GAME__*/` placeholders.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/build.mjs`: rebuilds `index.html`.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/vendor/three.min.js`: inlined Three.js r160.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/start.sh`: project server entry.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/capture.sh`: screenshot harness entry.
- `/home/runner/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/linux.json`: Chromium launch config used by runtime capture.

## Important Context
- `index.html` was built after latest source patches, but source edits after the last build may require rebuilding.
- Three.js console warning about deprecated UMD build is expected and harmless.
- Known areas to verify/fix:
  - `showGameOverModal` had a stray `陀` character that was patched out.
  - `stage.pickups` initialization fixed.
  - `radialTexture` fixed.
  - `startRun` cleanup of effects added.
  - Need verify menu dachshund visibility and game camera fit, especially table plus apron dog and backboard.
  - `eventLine` CSS currently may overlay a sliver of game stage; requirement says no playfield overlay, so inspect/change if needed.
  - K9 dog animation path is implemented but untested.
  - `k9sign` at `z=7.72` may occlude the apron dachshund; inspect.
  - Pickup expiry uses `simTime`; creation sets `pk.bornAt = simTime` in `damagePod`.
  - `makeTextSprite` textures for sector sign are regenerated per stage; dispose old map.
- Debug API: `window.WUMMI` exposes `start`, `menu`, `pause`, `ranking`, `difficulty`, `state`, `press`, `launch`, `score`, `stage`, `forceK9`.
- No git commit has been made.

## Objective
- Build a complete, self-contained, paste-ready HTML5 3D pinball game for mobile/tablet in 9:16 portrait, with zombie apocalypse/security-team theme, detailed animated dachshund, procedural levels, power-ups, sound, ranking, difficulties, and animated main menu.
- Required credits: developer **BANDOS7**, **Made in Germany**, version **1.1.1**.

## Requirements
- One-finger mobile controls.
- 9:16 portrait format, phone/tablet responsive.
- Ranking and multiple difficulty levels.
- Game sound and animated main menu.
- Pinball gameplay featuring zombies and security teams.
- Diverse power-ups, procedural levels, extras.
- Dark atmosphere, high quality, very detailed dachshund animation.
- Everything clearly visible; playfield must not be covered by UI.
- HTML5 copy/paste version.
- 3D game.
- Build now without clarifying questions; note assumptions briefly at finish.

## Decisions
- Single-file `index.html` with Three.js r160 UMD inlined (`vendor/three.min.js`).
- Custom 2D circle/segment physics rendered through Three.js, not a physics engine.
- Canvas sits in a dedicated stage between HUD and controls, so UI does not overlap the playfield.
- Audio and visual assets are procedural (Web Audio, Canvas textures, primitive 3D models).
- Local ranking in `localStorage` with seeded entries.
- One-finger controls: left/right flipper buttons plus central launch button.
- Difficulty keys: `recruit`, `veteran`, `nightmare`.
- LocalStorage keys: `wummi_rank_111`, `wummi_settings_111`.
- Root font scaling now drives rem layout so the entire UI fits 9:16 on phone/tablet/desktop.

## Work State
### Completed
- Full source authored: `src/shell.html`, `src/style.css`, `src/app.js`.
- `build.mjs` generates self-contained `index.html` (~830 KB); `node --check src/app.js` passes.
- Fixed major responsive bug: root font-size now follows app width; `#app` has `container-type: inline-size` so logo/panel fit on desktop/tablet/360px.
- Fixed launch-lane physics trap: removed blocking guide wall, repositioned right slingshot, changed top exit wall to `[2.2,-6.0]→[3.72,-5.2]`, shortened separator to `z=-4.2`; ball now launches into playfield and scores.
- Removed oversized biohazard roundel from playfield texture; replaced with small faint containment stencil.
- Reduced green stage-light hotspot; added fill/dog lights; brightened playfield base.
- Camera fit now includes full apron kennel/dog at `z≈8.45`; dog/pad no longer cut off.
- Moved event banner into HUD (no playfield overlay).
- Inline SVG favicon added; favicon 404 resolved.
- Debug/QA API expanded: `snapshot`, `addScore`, `end`, `power`, `spawnPickup`, plus existing controls.
- Verified via Playwright mobile (390×844): menu, start, launch, physics, scoring, K9, sector 2 transition, pause, ranking, briefing, game over, name save, ranking persistence across reload, nightmare difficulty with 2 balls, pickup collection, all power-ups/multiball; no JS errors.
- Verified layouts at 360×640, 390×844, 834×1194, 1440×900; menu/panel/logo fit.
- Credits/version checked in UI: BANDOS7, Made in Germany, v1.1.1.

### Active
- Final visual polish and regression pass after latest tweaks.
- Need inspect post-camera-change K9 leap screenshot and tablet game screenshot.
- Need test held flipper button (touch hold) and natural ball drain/shield behavior.
- No git commit made.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Rebuild `index.html` (`node build.mjs`) and rerun `node --check src/app.js`.
2. Capture final mobile K9 leap, tablet game, and held-flipper/drain tests; fix any remaining visual issues.
3. Verify power chips/objective readability and launch-lane visuals at 360×640.
4. Confirm audio/haptics toggles and natural game-over flow if feasible.
5. Deliver concise final note with assumptions, credits BANDOS7, Made in Germany, version 1.1.1.

## Relevant Files
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html`: final built single-file paste version.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/app.js`: game logic, scenes, physics, UI, audio, debug API.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/style.css`: layout, menu, game HUD, modals, responsive rules.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/shell.html`: HTML structure and injection placeholders.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/build.mjs`: rebuilds `index.html`.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/vendor/three.min.js`: inlined Three.js r160.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/start.sh`: starts project server on port 3000.
- `/tmp/opencode/test3.cjs`: full mobile/desktop flow test.
- `/tmp/opencode/test4.cjs`: power-up, ranking save/reload, nightmare test.
- `/tmp/opencode/appshots.cjs`: responsive element screenshots.

## Important Context
- Server currently running at `http://127.0.0.1:3000/`; screenshots in `/tmp/opencode/shots/`.

- Headless software WebGL runs slowly; wait on game state (`snapshot().k9Fx`, `stageClearTimer`) rather than fixed wall time.

content.text:
Good. Root font-size 10px but app scale script adjusts? `applyUiScale` likely sets font-size. Fine.

Now, does `#app` height 100dvh create a 9:16 width max. On a phone with 390x844, 844*0.5625=474.75 > 390 so width 100vw, height 844 -> aspect 0.462 (not 9:16 exactly). It uses full screen with HUD/controls; stage height 632. Requirement 9:16 portrait format, phone responsive. It's portrait but not strictly 9:16 because full viewport 390x844 is 0.462 not .5625. On tablets 834x1194 = 0.698, app constrained to 671.6 wide (1194*.5625) = 0.5625 exactly. On phone, 390x844 (iPhone 12) 0.462; they asked 9:16, but most phones are taller than 16:9. Should we force app width max 100vw and max-height 100dvh; it fills screen. The page is portrait, not strictly 9:16. "9:16 portrait format" usually means tall portrait. The stage itself is 390x632 = 0.617, not 9:16. But playfield is full width. The app's bounding would be 390x844 (9:19.5). On 360x640, 0.5625 exact. On tablet, exact. On iPhone, full height. Is that okay? "9:16 portrait format, phone/tablet responsive" likely means portrait orientation optimized. It's acceptable to fill the screen.

But if strict, could set `#app` height: min(100dvh, calc(100vw * 16 / 9)) and max-width: calc(100dvh * 9/16), centered, leaving bars on tall phones. That would create empty bands top/bottom on 390x844, which looks worse but matches 9:16. Most games fill the screen. The current approach uses available height, better. The playfield renders to fill. I think okay.

Now, there is a possible issue with `touch-action: none` on body preventing scrolling modal content on small screens; modals fit so fine. The modal card might have max-height and scroll. CSS around 650. Fine.

Now let's inspect the README maybe the original user instructions. The .agents/Agents.md might specify delivery protocol. Check.

## Process lifecycle

- Run long-lived servers and watchers in a persistent session such as tmux.
- Do not background them in bounded commands without explicit detachment and cleanup.
- After a timeout, inspect the process and endpoint before retrying or claiming failure.

## Linux browser and WebGPU capture

- Use the preinstalled `playwright-cli` executable from Actions or SSH.
- Use its headed Chromium, persistent Xvfb display, and SwiftShader configuration.
- Run `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` for the Pascal development server.
- Load a saved scene. Wait for actual geometry and the active WebGPU renderer.
- Run `playwright-cli screenshot --filename=screenshots/linux.png` after creating the output directory.
- Inspect the image. Reject loading screens, empty grids, and blank canvases.
- Report SwiftShader as CPU software rendering. Do not claim GPU hardware acceleration.
- Inspect `$HOME/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/linux.json` for launch settings.
- Use `playwright-cli --help` for commands and named sessions. Pass configuration only to `open`.

## Mobile browser games

- Support Android and iOS phones and tablets with responsive layouts and usable touch controls.
- Keep gameplay and controls visible within safe areas and avoid browser gesture conflicts.
- Add tilt controls only when appropriate; offer touch alternatives and request iOS motion permission from a user gesture when needed.
- Follow explicit device and control requirements in the user request.
